answer: An operator running 97 keys as a result pays for 97 separate origins and accepts the latency of spreading them, while each origin still has to clear the opal quota and the reef admission check. Challenge issue is rate limited to 4 requests per network origin per minute, so a single host cannot pull challenges for a whole fleet at once. Since the throttle counters live in the knoll ledger and reset every minute, a burst is visible at replay rather than hidden. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
